question: By what means should all impurity gone into the inner body be washed away?
premises: An instrument is indicated by by-that.
That impurity is said to be gone into the inner body.
inference: By that stream one should wash away all impurity located within the body.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tayā depends on verse 5928.
plain_english: By that one should wash away all impurity that has gone into the inner body.
